en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4212 - Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Ali ibn Ri'ab, from Zurara, who said:

I asked Abu Abdullah (as), about the rennet (infaha) that comes out of a dead kid (young goat).
Imam (as) said: "There is no harm in it."

I asked about the milk that is in the udder of a sheep that has died.
Imam (as) said: "There is no harm in it."

I asked about wool, hair, elephant bones, and an egg that is taken from a hen.
Imam (as) said: "All of these are pure and lawful; there is no harm in them."
